## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- claim-1 fails the required degree-\(6\) boundary witness: the artifact records \(V_6=[]\) because its zero-row branch loses the single column, rather than \(V_6=[1]\). Hence it does not certify \(U_6M_6V_6=D_6\) for \(M_6=D_6=0_{0\times1}\).
- The report explicitly concludes that the requested certificate is not established. The witnesses for degrees \(7,\ldots,20\) do not repair the missing degree-\(6\) case.

## Unresolved certificates
- [computation] Execute and preserve a corrected witness computation for all \(6\le d\le20\) that retains matrix column counts when there are no rows, explicitly outputs \(M_6=D_6=0_{0\times1}\), \(U_6=I_0\), \(V_6=[1]\), and verifies every equality \(U_dM_dV_d=D_d\) and every applicable determinant \(\det U_d,\det V_d=\pm1\).
